checks.title: AI search crawlers are allowed in robots.txt
checks.why: Search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot) fetch pages to answer questions and link sources. Blocking them removes you from those answers.
checks.evidence: All 8 AI search and user crawlers may fetch /.

checks.title: AI training crawlers
checks.why: Training crawlers collect data for future models. Blocking them is a business choice and does not remove you from live AI search.

checks.title: Your server or CDN lets AI crawlers through
checks.why: Firewalls and CDNs (for example Cloudflare's AI-bot blocking) can reject AI crawlers even when robots.txt allows them. This is invisible unless you test with their real user agents.
checks.evidence: OAI-SearchBot 200, GPTBot 200, ClaudeBot 200, PerplexityBot 200: same content as a browser.

checks.title: llms.txt guide for AI
checks.why: A plain-Markdown map of your key pages for AI tools. Low cost; adoption by the big engines is still limited, so it's a small bonus, not a fix.
checks.fix: Add /llms.txt. `getcited --fix` drafts one from your pages.

checks.title: Sitemap is published
checks.why: Helps crawlers find every page, including new ones.

priorities.title: Structured data (JSON-LD) describes the page
priorities.why: Schema.org markup states facts — who, what, when, price, rating — in a form machines read without guessing.
priorities.fix: Add Organization (or Person) and an Article, Product, FAQPage or WebPage block. `getcited --fix` drafts one.

priorities.title: Cites authoritative sources
priorities.why: Pages that link their claims to primary sources were cited markedly more often in the GEO study.
priorities.fix: Link each key claim to its primary source.

priorities.title: Named author or publisher
priorities.why: Engines prefer content with a clear, accountable source.
priorities.fix: Add a named author and an Organization publisher in JSON-LD, plus a visible byline.

priorities.title: Brand is defined as an entity
priorities.why: sameAs links tie your brand to profiles models already know (LinkedIn, Wikipedia, Crunchbase…).
priorities.fix: Add an Organization (or Person) node with name, url, logo and sameAs links to your official profiles.

priorities.title: Quotes from people or experts
priorities.why: Attributed quotations were another top-performing signal in the GEO study.
priorities.fix: Add one or two real quotes from named experts, customers or your own team, with attribution.
